- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.
- After a sharp price spike (≥ 5% from prior peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2–4% above recent high for 3–7 days.
- If sentiment is negative (≤ -0.33) and price is trending down, model underestimates; add 1–2% to forecast for 5–10 days to avoid premature bottoming.
- Model consistently underestimates in early 30-day horizon when sentiment is mixed (0.00–0.67); apply +1–2% bias to first 5–7 days.
- Mean reversion bias: if price is above 30-day moving average for 3+ days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% per day until reversion.
- Sentiment reversal (e.g., from +0.67 to -0.33) triggers model lag; delay forecast adjustment by 1–2 days and reduce by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.
